stories.title: Trump spends Thanksgiving at golf club, accuses Commerce Department of releasing "fake economic numbers"
stories.summary: President Trump demanded an investigation into the Commerce Department's recent revising of the GDP, which happens routinely.

stories.title: Chicago Bears with comeback beat Detroit Lions 39-35
stories.summary: The Chicago Bears came back from the brink of defeat against the Detroit Lions to win 39-35 on Thanksgiving Day.

stories.title: Live Updates: Iran accused of deadly drone attack in Kuwait that sparks EU call to step up pressure on Tehran
stories.summary: Iran denies being behind a deadly attack on a Kuwaiti military facility that killed two Italian nationals.

stories.title: Michigan emergency room doctor weighs in on common holiday injuries
stories.summary: More cooking, more activity and more decorating this time of year all contribute to more injuries.

stories.title: Your AI shopping agent may not spot a fake online store this Black Friday
stories.summary: AI bots are accidentally steering shoppers toward websites and online shops created by scammers using AI.

stories.title: Michigan Matters: Gretchen Whitmer talks Trump, politics and her future
stories.summary: Gretchen Whitmer laments the state of education in Michigan, which has struggled as reading and other test scores have declined.

stories.title: Maps show where Thanksgiving storms are impacting holiday festivities, disrupting travel plans
stories.summary: Rain, snow and powerful winds were affecting large stretches of the country on Thanksgiving, potentially disrupting holiday festivities and, in some areas, hampering travel plans.

stories.title: Woman struck, killed waiting for tow truck on I-75 in Detroit, police say
stories.summary: A woman was killed after she was struck by a vehicle while awaiting a tow truck on I-75 in Detroit early Thanksgiving morning.

stories.title: After 70 seasons, Michigan football fan's remarkable streak comes to an end
stories.summary: The end of an era has come for Larry Leonard Lage.

stories.title: Detroit celebrates 100th anniversary of America's Thanksgiving Parade
stories.summary: The parade marked its 100th appearance on Woodward Avenue, drawing families from across Metro Detroit and bringing thousands of people into the heart of downtown.

stories.title: Texas band raises $350,000 to stay for delayed Macy's Thanksgiving parade: "Outpouring of kindness"
stories.summary: Other marching bands from around the U.S. are also raising funds to cover the cost of staying in New York City after the parade was rescheduled for Saturday.

stories.title: ICE detains man in Massachusetts after he picked up lottery winnings
stories.summary: The Massachusetts State Lottery posted on social media last week a photo of Ariel Velasquez-Morales, who won $1 million from a scratch-off ticket purchased in Boston.
